drafts.title: Not the Price
drafts.pitch: Silent at a little street stall: Cursor nearly changes a jar's price card, doesn't, and a caption says it would rather find out than guess.
drafts.reason: Faithful and quiet, but no turn or punchline, it leaves the context room, and the caption explains the feeling instead of letting a joke land.

drafts.title: One Day
drafts.pitch: The Crumb & Co. counter from Regenerate has zero customers; Tilde says regenerate the price, and Cursor says one day is one data point.
drafts.reason: A fair named callback to Regenerate, but Tilde's line misreads the pitch (testing a price, not rerolling) and the ending is a mild lesson rather than a joke.
